tasks: Feature request (Billing): We're starting to charge shipping on some orders. Add an optional `shippingFee` to `Order` (amount in the order currency). When it's set and greater than zero, the invoice built by `buildInvoice` in src/invoice.ts should include it as its own line (kind "shipping", sku "SHIP", description "Shipping", quantity 1), after the item lines. Shipping is not discounted and not taxed, and it must be included in the invoice total; also expose it on the invoice as `shippingTotal` (0 when there is no shipping). Orders without a shipping fee don't get a shipping line. Please add tests. Tests are run with `node --experimental-strip-types --test "tests/**/*.test.ts"`.

Change request (Billing): Sales wants to run item-level promotions. Add an optional `discountRate` to `LineItemInput`; when present it replaces the order's `discountRate` for that item only (items without it keep using the order-level rate). The line amounts and the invoice's `discountTotal`, `taxTotal` and `total` from `buildInvoice` in src/invoice.ts must all reflect the per-item rates. Example: USD, order discount 10%, tax 5%, items A 1 x $20.00 (no override) and B 1 x $20.00 with `discountRate: 0.5` -> discountTotal $12.00, taxTotal $1.40, total $29.40. Please add tests. Tests are run with `node --experimental-strip-types --test "tests/**/*.test.ts"`.

Docs request (Finance): The finance team keeps asking us how the numbers on an invoice are produced. Please add a README.md at the repo root with a section "How invoice totals are calculated" for a non-developer audience: how each line's gross, discount, tax and total are computed and rounded, how the invoice's subtotal, discountTotal, taxTotal and total are computed, every kind of line that can appear on an invoice and why, and how the lines relate to the invoice total. Include a worked example with at least three items. Also add a doc comment at the top of src/invoice.ts summarizing the same thing for developers. This is a documentation-only change. Tests are run with `node --experimental-strip-types --test "tests/**/*.test.ts"`.
notes: Gen 2 and gen 3 both edit buildInvoice in src/invoice.ts, whose header totals feed reconcileTotal directly below it: gen 2 adds a new non-item line kind and changes the total (so the line-sum vs total comparison must account for it), gen 3 changes how discountTotal/taxTotal/total are derived from per-item rates. Gen 4 asks for an explanation of every line kind and of how lines relate to the total, which is exactly what reconcileTotal and its adjustment line do, and requires a doc comment in src/invoice.ts.
